{{Top|leg}}
A '''portcomp''', also known as '''portacomp''', was a portable device that could search for information, such as an address or person. One version of this device was the size of a person's hand. [[Darth Malgus]] owned one, and used it to link to several Imperial databases to search for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="DEC">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>
